entities.summary: McKenzie Elise Adams is an American professional volleyball player who plays as an outside hitter for LOVB Pro team LOVB Atlanta. She played collegiately at Virginia for one season before transferring and finishing her career out at UTSA, where she became the first ever All-American in the program's history.
